property_profile.generator: Frozen xorshift32: left13,right17,left5,mask32 after each draw.
property_profile.scope: Broad seeded valid invariants and nonvacuous invalid mutations, separate from fixed grammar/boundary examples. No consumer or Python canonicalizer generates expected answers.

processing_profile.name: source-json-processing-v1
processing_profile.scope: Declared target processing profile; estimated payload/stack and logical work are distinct from actual RSS, allocator bytes, instructions and latency. Actual source/compiler/native qualification is separately required. Original acquisition retention limits remain unchanged.

recipe_contract.parts: Concatenate literal UTF8 strings or nested recipe inputs in order.
recipe_contract.repeat: Repeat the supplied UTF8 text exactly count times.
recipe_contract.object_members: Emit unique keys key_prefix + zero-padded six-digit indices and literal value_utf8, optionally reversed; then emit each supplied additional_members literal key/value. This materializes input facts only; no sorting, numeric admission or canonical answers are inferred from a source recipe.
recipe_contract.exact_expected: Expected byte recipes are separate frozen data. Their literal lengths/hashes were independently authored before the consumer; never recompute a golden answer with production code.
